compiler_contract.cache_contract: Caller supplies the seven exact integer cache registers coherently consistent with the exact-K portfolio register; preparation is outside the compiled ordered mixer layer.
compiler_contract.cache_normalization: For each edge and constraint row, deterministically conjugate one endpoint cache by the exact signed coefficient difference so both endpoint encodings share one canonical cache value during the two-level rotation.
compiler_contract.coherent_pair_identity: C_inverse times controlled_XY times C maps |10,A10> and |01,A01> exactly within their two-dimensional encoded subspace when A01=A10+c_j-c_i.
compiler_contract.constant_addition: Two-pattern-controlled exact two's-complement addition modulo 2^w, synthesized as descending multi-controlled increments inherited from the authenticated proof-carrying compiler.
compiler_contract.dead_edge_policy: Emit a certified identity position only when an exact-K conditional reachable interval is disjoint from the symmetric feasible interval for at least one constraint row.
compiler_contract.expanded_gate_materialization: NOT_REQUIRED; canonical macro schedules, exact closed-form expansion counts and inherited elementary templates are hashed and independently replayed.
compiler_contract.different_bit_guard: Compute d=x_i XOR x_j into clean scratch; the aggregate guard includes d and d is uncomputed only after the restored portfolio pair and caches are available.
compiler_contract.interval_guard: Let delta=c_i-c_j and q in {0,1} name the chosen canonical endpoint orientation. After cache normalization to B=A_q, both endpoints satisfy row r iff B lies in [max(L,L-(1-2q)delta), min(U,U-(1-2q)delta)].
compiler_contract.normalization_orientation: Choose independently per edge and constraint the endpoint orientation q with the lower exact selected-model normalization CNOT cost; ties choose q=1 (the 10 endpoint).
compiler_contract.ordered_layer: All 780 canonical positions remain present in order as either a live compiled rotation or a proof-carrying identity record.
compiler_contract.reachable_range: For an oriented 10-to-01 edge on the exact-K domain, the canonical cache range is c_i plus the sums of the K-1 smallest and largest remaining coefficients; the 01 orientation is symmetric.
compiler_contract.static_simplification: A lower or upper comparator may be removed only when the exact conditional reachable interval proves it identically true; no sampled or witness-only pruning is allowed.
compiler_contract.uncompute_order: Compute d, normalize caches, compute interval flags and aggregate guard, apply the Gray-conjugated controlled rotation, uncompute aggregate and interval flags while caches remain normalized, denormalize caches using the new endpoint orientation, then clear d.
compiler_contract.xy_template: Two CX Gray conjugations around one aggregate-controlled CRX using the inherited two-CX CRX template; the aggregate flag already contains the different-bit condition.

evidence_contract.canonical_payload: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators, excluding the self-hash field
evidence_contract.immutability: An existing non-identical artifact is never overwritten.
evidence_contract.per_edge_manifest: Every canonical position contributes a deterministic row hash; the ordered hash chain commits to all 780 positions without requiring a monolithic expanded gate file.
evidence_contract.replay: Two independent builds must reproduce every seed hash, ledger total, validation hash and final artifact identity.
